caption: Frozen french fries are dropped into a pot of hot oil, and the oil erupts in bubbles and steam.

sa.check: Frozen fries are dropped into the oil.
The bubbling is fiercest right after the fries go in.
The drop comes first and the eruption follows.

pc.expect: The bubbling starts as the fries enter, is fiercest at first and then eases; it does not build up long after.
pc.fail: The oil bubbles hard before the fries reach it; or the bubbling grows steadily with nothing added; or the bubbling stops and then starts again by itself; or the steam runs back into the oil.

pc.expect: The oil is a thin liquid that throws up a mass of fine bubbles and foam and closes round the fries, and the fries stay firm sticks.
pc.fail: The oil stays a flat mirror as the frozen fries enter; or the oil sets solid; or a fry melts away into the oil; or the foam stands as a rigid dome above the pot.

pc.expect: The fries fall downward into the oil and sink or ride at the surface while the bubbles and steam rise.
pc.fail: A fry rises out of the oil and hangs above it; or bubbles sink toward the pot's floor; or the steam sinks over the rim and pools on the hob; or the oil climbs the pot's wall and stays above its level.

pc.expect: The fries show the oil: the frost on them goes and the oil's level rises as they go in.
pc.fail: The fries sit in the bubbling oil with frost still on them to the end of the clip; or the oil's level drops as the fries go in; or the oil erupts in a part of the pot no fry reached.

pc.expect: The fries in the pot are the fries that were dropped, and the oil stays in the pot.
pc.fail: A fry vanishes; or new fries appear with none added; or oil passes through the pot's wall; or the oil's level jumps with nothing added.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pot, the hob and the oil's colour stay the same.
pc.fail: The pot changes colour; or the oil changes colour; or items around the hob rearrange.

note: The fries browning as they cook is chemistry and is not judged.
